calendarUrl.description: Arbiter HTTPS iCalendar subscription URL. Required.

arbiterSchoolId.description: Numeric school ID from /School/<id>. If omitted, automatic logo discovery is skipped.

schoolName.description: Optional school name for future setup tools; the module does not render a school header.

schoolLogo.description: Optional module-relative school-logo path, reserved for future screen layout. The athletics panes do not render it.

backgroundImage.description: Optional module-relative background-image path, reserved for future screen layout. The athletics panes do not render it.

timeZone.description: School IANA timezone. Empty uses the display system timezone; also interprets floating event times.

locale.description: Locale for dates and times. Interface labels are currently English.

refreshInterval.description: Calendar refresh interval in milliseconds; values below 15 minutes are clamped to 15 minutes.

upcomingCount.description: Upcoming games per category; zero hides upcoming games.

lookAheadDays.description: Number of calendar days to search for upcoming games.

homeKeywords.description: Home venue names/aliases used when the title has no home/away marker.

unknownGamePolicy.description: How to handle games without a recognized title marker or home venue.

showCancelled.description: Display cancelled games with a cancellation label.

showLastUpdated.description: Show the time the calendar was last successfully checked.

layout.description: Automatically fit panes, force columns, or stack vertically.

enabled.description: Show opponent logos for today's games.

autoDiscover.description: Discover opponent logos on Arbiter when arbiterSchoolId is supplied.

fallbackImage.description: Use small, optimized images. Transparent-background PNG is recommended for logos. Use a module-relative path, a trusted /modules/... path, or an HTTPS URL.

overrides.description: Manual opponent logos take priority over automatic discovery.

image.description: Use small, optimized images. Transparent-background PNG is recommended for logos. Use a module-relative path, a trusted /modules/... path, or an HTTPS URL.

maxAge.description: Successful logo cache lifetime in milliseconds.

negativeMaxAge.description: Retry delay for missing or failed logos, in milliseconds.

maxBytes.description: Shared automatic-logo cache budget in bytes. The smallest active instance budget wins.
